_note: Every campus-specific string the class picker and the rail show lives here, never in code. `campuses` is a list: a new campus is a new entry, never a code change. Per campus: id, label, term and term_label, pre_enrollment and roster_updates_until (null when unknown). Then start_card (the home card), closed_notice (the picker with no roster), rail_closed_line (the rail with no roster) and privacy_line. Then eligibility (category id to words) and programs. Each program has its categories and its v15 program group: business, analytics, cs, ece, infosci, or null. The programs stay for the eligibility labels and the IE entry; the picker no longer asks the program. Then relevance (the band thresholds) and catalog (true once the campus has a roster). Then catalog_file, tags_file and field_subjects (see the Cornell Tech entry). The two files are the roster and the skills each class names; pipeline.catalog_export and pipeline/catalog_tags.mjs write them. A program row marked unverified is a first pass the owner has not confirmed. `node evals/copy.mjs` checks every string in this file against the writing rule.

campuses.field_subjects_note: The tie-break of the picker's sorts (Catalog.inField). For each role field id of web/data/graph_mba.json `groups` (the product field included), the roster subjects whose classes belong to that field. Two cards equal on gap weight and score sort the one in the chosen roles' fields first. A first read of the 121 Spring 2027 classes' subjects; a subject missing here only loses the tie-break.
